description.value: Choices Market is a B.C.-owned natural and organic grocery chain; the Parksville location, which opened in August 2023, is the company's first Vancouver Island store and its 11th overall. The 22,000 sq ft store carries a wide selection of organic produce, local and specialty foods, natural wellness products, and hosts an in-store Pure Integrative Pharmacy. It was recognised as Organic Retailer of the Year 2025 by the Canada Organic Trade Association and won the 2025 PQB News Readers' Choice Award for the Oceanside community.
